svg.title: Разгибание рук с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing resistance-band triceps pushdown, side three-quarter view. Show a simple visible high fixed ring on a narrow upright post in front of the athlete, a continuous taut elastic band running directly from ring to two hands. In both phases upper arms vertical beside ribs, upright torso. START elbows bent 90 degrees, hands near lower chest. FINISH forearms extended down to hands by thighs, elbows nearly straight, upper arms and fixed overhead anchor unchanged. No cable or weight stack. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
